Autoclave.fact: An autoclave is a machine used to carry out industrial and scientific processes requiring elevated temperature and pressure in relation to ambient pressure and temperature. Autoclave tape.fact: Autoclave tape is an adhesive tape used in autoclaving (heating under high pressure with steam to sterilise) to indicate whether a specific temperature has been reached. Autolysis (biology).subject: Food Processing
Autolysis (biology).question: The _____ was Destruction of a cell through the action of its own enzymes.
Autolysis (biology).fact: In biology, autolysis, more commonly called self-digestion, refers to the destruction of a cell through the action of its own enzymes. It may also refer to the digestion of an enzyme by another molecule of the same enzyme.

Bacon.question: The _____ was Type of salt-cured pork.
Bacon.fact: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically the belly or less fatty parts of the back. Baicoli.subject: Food Processing

Bain-marie.subject: Food Processing

Sterilization (microbiology).subject: Food Processing
Sterilization (microbiology).question: The _____ was Process that eliminates all biological agents on an object or in a volume.
Sterilization (microbiology).fact: Sterilization (British English: sterilisation) refers to any process that removes, kills, or deactivates all forms of life (particularly microorganisms such as fungi, bacteria, spores, and unicellular eukaryotic organisms) and other biological agents (such as prions or viruses) present in fluid or on a specific surface or object. Sterilization can be achieved through various means, including heat, chemicals, irradiation, high pressure, and filtration.

✓ Acaçá.question: The _____ was Maize dish in Brazil.
✓ Acaçá.fact: Acaçá (from Fon language: àkàsà, also called ẹ̀kọ in Yorùbá language) is a ritual food central to ceremonies of Afro-Brazilian religions, specifically to Candomblé rituals.
